Mad Dog II - The Lost Gold.name: Mad Dog II: The Lost Gold
Mad Dog II - The Lost Gold.summary: The sequel to American Laser Game's original Mad Dog McCree, with pretty much the same gameplay and motion capture graphics. This PC conversion seems to have been tweaked a bit to be more stable than the original Mad Dog. There's also somewhat limited replay value as you can choose from 3 different guides for 3 different routes through the game.
